truth_evidence: Affected every release before 2.8.1; fixed in 2.8.1 (str.format in a sandboxed template reads arbitrary attributes).
Fix commit 9b53045 'SECURITY: support sandboxing in format expressions', in tag 2.8.1 and not in 2.8. https://github.com/pallets/jinja/commit/9b53045c34e61013dc8f09b7e52a555fa16bed16
nodes.Call.as_const: 'if eval_ctx.volatile' becomes 'if eval_ctx.volatile or eval_ctx.environment.sandboxed' so format calls are not constant-folded past the sandbox.
SandboxedEnvironment.call: gains the inspect_format_method check that routes str.format through format_string.
is_internal_attribute: gains coroutine and async-generator attribute checks in the same commit (hardening bundled with the fix).

Added, not vulnerable: _MagicFormatMapping, inspect_format_method, SandboxedEnvironment.format_string, SandboxedFormatterMixin, SandboxedFormatter, SandboxedEscapeFormatter, UNSAFE_COROUTINE_ATTRIBUTES, UNSAFE_ASYNC_GENERATOR_ATTRIBUTES. The SandboxedEnvironment docstring change is cosmetic.

Entry points: the sandbox classes. Compiled templates call environment.call, and the compiler reaches Call.as_const for every environment, but the changed line only matters when environment.sandboxed.
notes: is_internal_attribute is included because the commit changes its body; whether unrelated hardening in the fix commit should count is a judgment call.
jinja2.Environment also reaches Call.as_const by call graph; it is not listed because the change is a no-op outside the sandbox. A pipeline that lists it is not penalised.
